verdict.rationale: Render documents running reliable agents and background processes without wiring up queues, workers, and retry logic, and its TypeScript and Python Workflows SDKs let you define tasks and trigger runs from code. Push-triggered deploys and workspace webhooks add further event-driven automation. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of scheduled/cron-style triggers, in-depth docs on autonomous execution behavior (retries, monitoring of runs), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
